scope: Source and supplied pure-manufactured-control review for exactly existing cases 20 and 28. No new geometry, FK, optimizer on saved grasps or inference executed by this reviewer.

FD probes, raw proposals, optimizer success flags and rejected exact checkpoints cannot be selected.

Raw/exact budgets reserve two calls; cache is bounded; derivative staging is separately counted. Wall time is cooperative, not a preemptive deadline.

Driver records all static forwards including reconstruction/start binding and asserts zero physics/time; source proposals unchanged.

Authored sixteen manufactured controls inspect actual progress plus nonlinear tip/hard failures, exact pass/eligibility loss, current-rank comparison, cache key, fallback, boundary arithmetic and finite numeric refusal.
budget_accounting_note: Each case also makes one driver start-binding exact check outside the solver maximum 96 exact checks. The driver forward counter includes reconstruction, this check, solver raw/exact callbacks and analytic-Jacobian staging.
limitations: Retained witnesses are a capped subset, not full-field mapping acceptance.
